summary: The server-authoritative age/stage profile, immutable configuration audit, rights-gated documentary catalogue, four structurally distinct Android stage homes and bounded feedback engine passed all offline engineering gates; physical-tablet interaction remains blocked.

environment.postgresContainerLifecycle: isolated random-name localhost container with no persistent volume; exact container removed in finally

checks.result: All six Maven reactor modules compiled with Stage20 domain, application, JDBC and REST code.

Three domain vectors and two H2 MockMvc scenarios passed: age boundaries, override/feedback rules, RBAC, cross-family hiding, version conflict, immutable audit, access-mode validation, idempotent approval/withdrawal and child-safe projection.
H2 full regression passed with 17 domain tests and 20 Boot tests; five PostgreSQL-only tests were conditionally skipped. Flyway V1-V9 and Hibernate validate passed.

checks.command: start isolated localhost PostgreSQL 16.15 container; export test datasource only for the Maven process; .\mvnw.cmd test; remove exact container in finally
checks.result: PostgreSQL 16.15 full regression passed with 17 domain and 20 Boot/API/concurrency tests, zero failures/errors/skips; 9 migrations and 39 production tables validated. The temporary container was removed and no volume was created.

checks.command: .\gradlew.bat testDebugUnitTest testReleaseUnitTest lintDebug lintRelease assembleDebug assembleRelease
checks.result: 111 tasks succeeded on the final source tree; 24 debug and 24 release JVM tests, both lint variants and both APK builds passed. Tests cover age boundaries, safe override/reduced-motion policy, remote experience refresh and parent update; the local decoder keeps an explicit missing-experience fallback for pre-Stage20 JSON.

checks.command: .\scripts\Test-DocumentationLinks.ps1; parse all evidence JSON and docs/openapi.yaml
checks.result: 85 Markdown files and 84 indexed documents passed local-link validation; all 20 evidence JSON files parsed; OpenAPI 3.1 parsed with 51 paths and the Stage20 request schemas.

acceptance.AC20-01: PASS - server recommendation, protected override/clear path, haptic setting, child self-read, optimistic version and immutable audit are implemented and tested.
acceptance.AC20-02: PASS - stage capabilities and feedback profiles differ, and Android routes to story stage, exploration notebook, subject lab and study studio rather than recolouring one dashboard.
acceptance.AC20-03: PASS_OFFLINE - bounded primary-action animation, visible press state, stage-specific short haptics, system animation-scale and haptic-off degradation passed build/unit inspection; physical feedback quality awaits the target tablet.
acceptance.AC20-04: PASS - rights holder/reference, stage, access mode, DRAFT/APPROVED/WITHDRAWN and expiry are enforced; child projection omits launchable URLs and rights metadata.
acceptance.AC20-05: PASS - H2/PostgreSQL 16.15, Android debug/release JVM/lint/build, OpenAPI and documentation gates passed.
acceptance.AC20-06: BLOCKED - target-tablet haptics, Reduced Motion, TalkBack, orientation, restart persistence and live server synchronisation were not executed.

blocked: An Android tablet or phone with USB debugging is required for V20-05: all four stage layouts, physical haptics and haptic-off behaviour, system Reduced Motion, TalkBack, rotation, app restart and live service synchronisation.
